name: Tri-Color Customer
description: A 9-marble customer split into 3 vertical color strips with 3 rows of single-marble holes. Only the front row takes marbles (one of each color); when it is full, the row unclips like a Lego brick and the next row moves up.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to send marbles down. The striped Tri-Color customers at the bottom need one marble of each of their 3 colors in the front row. When the row is full it snaps off and the next row becomes active. Clear every customer to win.
author: Seckin Ege Aydemir

showcaseLevel.name: Tri-Color Customer
showcaseLevel.desc: Two Tri-Color customers: fill each row with one marble of each color
